text:
Alice (infra PM): Heads up — Q4 hosted API capacity decision. We need to finalize buy vs lease mix for the holiday surge window (Nov 20–Dec 10). I ran a baseline projection and we should decide buffer policy + fast lease fallback. Proposal: reserve 50 owned A100-equivalent, lease up to 100 for burst. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Ben (eng-infra): quick note — APAC supply availability looks tight in Nov (supplier told procurement 6–9 week lead). US-west/central is okay. Leasing will be the only short-term lever for APAC spikes.
Emily (ops): can we get the projected GPU-hours per day? that drives the cost math and whether batching improvements help enough to avoid leases.
Alice (infra PM): posting the rough projection I used — numbers are conservative (includes 15% safety):
```
Scenario   rps_peak  tok/s  avg_seq  GPUs_needed  GPU-hours/day
Baseline   1200      220k  512      80           1920
Holiday    1800      330k  640     120           2880
Extreme    2300      420k  700     160           3840
```
Ben (eng-infra): those GPUs_needed assume current batching + no extra quantization, right? If we flip to 8-bit at inference we can drop ~20–25% GPU requirement for the same throughput.
Dave (SRE): cluster note — our us-west network spine has ~15% headroom; sustained spikes above Holiday plan will start queuing at the network layer unless we partition traffic and shift some load to us-east. Also tagging: we need to increase kube node port limit if we add >40 nodes quickly.
Carla (finance): rough cost delta I ran — compare 12-month amortized buy vs 3-month lease during Q4: 
```
Option A (buy 50 GPUs): CapEx ~ $3.5M amortized = $291k/mo => Q4 impact ~ $291k*3 = $873k (plus infra ops)
Option B (lease 100 GPUs for 3 months): OpEx ~ $85k/mo => Q4 cost ~ $255k
Combo (buy 50 + lease 70): Q4 incremental ~ $291k + $170k = $461k
```
Carla (finance): these are ballpark — need procurement quote for exact numbers.
Ben (eng-infra): recommendation: lock 50 buys for baseline growth, pre-stage lease quotes for +70, and keep an on-call commit window to convert leases into buys if usage persists > 12 weeks. That gives us ~10% safety buffer from owners.
Emily (ops): +1 on staged approach. Also propose enabling predictive prefix caching for high-traffic routes (we measured 12% token reduction on smaller tests) — if that holds it reduces GPU-hours by ~10%.
Alice (infra PM): action item: decide by EOD Tuesday so procurement can start RFQs. If we go buy+lease we need PO approvals. Can product teams sign off to shift non-critical traffic to us-east for the 3-week peak? @Dave?
Dave (SRE): can do, but need a quick canary to validate cross-region latency. I suggest a 2-day canary at 30% traffic shift. If OK, we can ramp to 70% for the peak.
Ben (eng-infra): procurement lead times from vendors: buy = 6–8 weeks (hardware + rack/install), lease = 7–14 days for availability if vendor has inventory. So Tuesday decision still works for leases, buys are next quarter earliest for delivery.
Carla (finance): i need final cost with 12-month amortization and the lease burn rate. please add an amortization line to the combo scenario.
Alice (infra PM): noted. I'll update numbers today and post a final diff. If we do buy 50 + lease 70, ops to prepare scaling playbook and SRE to test cross-region canary. Procurement to trigger lease quotes immediately after sign-off.
capacity-bot: Lease quote request created: request_id=RQ-202611-341 (vendors: VendorA, VendorB). ETA for vendor responses: 48–72h.
Emily (ops): alternative mitigation — roll a quantized variant on 20% of traffic during surge window. That combined with prefix caching might let us reduce leases by ~30 GPUs. Worth modeling as a lower-cost fallback.
Dave (SRE): canary plan: run traffic-shift script and monitor tail-p99 latency + network retransmits. If p99 > 350ms or retransmits spike, abort and fallback to baseline region split.
Ben (eng-infra): final ops note — GPU reservation policy: keep 10% reserved for control plane/critical routing so we don't eat all capacity with background eval jobs. Also tag instances with `holiday-burst` and `critical-only`.
Carla (finance): put a hard cap on lease spend for Q4? I'd suggest $400k max without exec sign-off.
Alice (infra PM): good call. I'll put together a decision doc with three options: buy-only (50), buy+lease (50+70), lease-heavy (0+140). Will include ops runbook, canary steps, costs, and approval matrix. Posting by 5pm PT today. :clipboard:
Ben (eng-infra): thumbs up. I'll prepare the `redwood infra capacity apply` snippets for each scenario and the autoscaler policies. Example: `redwood infra capacity apply --region us-west --gpus 70 --tag holiday-burst`
Alice (infra PM): thanks everyone — timeline: Tuesday EOD decision, procurement starts RFQ, ops & SRE run canary next week.
Carla (finance): noting budget guardrail $400k for leases unless exec sign-off.
Emily (ops): I'll start toggles for prefix caching + quantized rollout on staging to capture savings numbers.
Dave (SRE): I'll draft the canary playbook and post a runbook link here when ready.
Alice (infra PM): perfect. I'll update the thread with the final decision doc and attach procurement checklist. :white_check_mark:
